name: per-project-extensions
description: Enable only the extensions each project needs, listed in .vscode/required-extensions.json, to save memory and CPU.

commands.title: Open in Project Profile (Only Required Extensions)
Reopen Window With Unrequired Extensions Disabled

projectExtensions.enabled.markdownDescription: Turn Per-Project Extensions on or off. When off it does no background work at all: no status bar item, no file watchers, no startup check and no syncing of `required-extensions.json`. Takes effect immediately; can be set per workspace.

projectExtensions.alwaysEnabled.markdownDescription: Extension IDs to keep enabled in every project in addition to `.vscode/required-extensions.json` (e.g. `github.copilot`, `vscodevim.vim`). Merged from user and workspace settings.

projectExtensions.keepDeclarativeExtensi.description: Also keep extensions that have no code (themes, icon themes, grammars, snippets, keymaps) even when not listed in required-extensions.json. Off by default: only listed extensions stay enabled. Can be overridden per project in required-extensions.json.

projectExtensions.maxFilesToScan.description: Maximum number of workspace files sampled to detect languages.

projectExtensions.excludeGlob.description: Glob of folders skipped while scanning.

projectExtensions.notifyOnStartup.description: On startup, notify when unneeded extensions are running in this workspace.

projectExtensions.cliPath.description: Optional absolute path to the VS Code CLI (code / code.cmd). Auto-detected when empty.

projectExtensions.syncOnInstall.markdownDescription: Keep `.vscode/required-extensions.json` in sync: installing an extension in this project's window adds it, uninstalling removes it (even if it is still running until restart). Only the focused window updates its file.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile
scripts.sandbox:setup: code --user-data-dir .sandbox/user-data --extensions-dir .sandbox/extensions --install-extension dbaeumer.vscode-eslint --install-extension esbenp.prettier-vscode --install-extension editorconfig.editorconfig --install-extension golang.go --install-extension redhat.vscode-yaml --install-extension mikestead.dotenv --install-extension streetsidesoftware.code-spell-checker
